semantic_ground_truth.task_summary_en: Grid block collection task: Visit all colored blocks in optimal order (TSP), then reach red endpoint. 10×10 grid with 3-5 blocks.
semantic_ground_truth.task_summary_zh: 网格方块收集任务：按最优顺序（TSP）访问所有彩色方块，然后到达红色终点。10×10网格，包含3-5个方块。

scoring_contract.notes: Agent must visit all blocks in optimal order (TSP), then reach red endpoint.

generic_declarative_render.prompt: The scene shows a 10×10 grid with a green start cell, a red end cell, and colored block cells (purple, pink, blue). An orange circular agent starts at the green cell and can move to adjacent cells (up, down, left, right). The agent must visit all colored blocks (purple, pink, blue) in order, taking the shortest path between consecutive targets, then reach the red end cell. Only modify what the task requires; keep the background and any other element unchanged.
